entities.name: Jan Šátral
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jan Šátral is an inactive Czech tennis player. Šátral has a career-high ATP singles ranking of No. 136 achieved on 3 October 2016. He also has a career-high doubles ranking of world No. 160 achieved on 21 September 2015. He has won two Challenger and nine ITF singles titles as well as two Challenger and 21 ITF doubles titles.
